bagPolicy.summary: The Kia Forum allows clear bags up to 12 x 6 x 12 inches and small clutches or wristlets up to 9 x 6 inches. All bags are subject to search.
allowed: Clear bags up to 12 x 6 x 12 inches
Small clutches/wristlets up to 9 x 6 inches
bagPolicy.note: Diaper and medical bags accompanied by the Guest using them are permitted.

parking.note: Onsite parking is available at the Kia Forum with entrances via Prairie Ave. or Kareem Ct. gates. Cash and all major credit cards are accepted. Carpooling and public transportation are encouraged.

rideshare.note: Drop-offs are permitted at all entrances. Use Lot H at Pincay Drive and Prairie Avenue for rideshare pickup.

concessions.note: The Kia Forum offers a variety of food and drink options featuring popular Southern California brands like Carney’s, Fresh Brothers Pizza, and Papa Cantella’s Hot Dogs. Alcoholic beverages include Casamigos Tequila, Cîroc, Jack Daniels, and Stella. The venue also has checkout-free stores for quick access to snacks and drinks.

accessibility.title: ADA & Accessible Services
accessibility.body: ADA accessible seating and entrances. Wheelchair services available. Contact venue for accommodations.

ticketPickup.title: Will Call
ticketPickup.body: The Box Office is open Fridays from 12 p.m. to 6 p.m. On show days, it opens at 12 p.m. and stays open until the show starts. Hours can change.

gates.title: Gates & Entrances
gates.body: Scan your ticket to enter the outdoor terrace that surrounds the venue. Terrace opening times are listed on each event page.
